evidence: Reviewed PROG_LIST parameter table, filters, pagination and formats plus authored offline tests; no native program-directory execution

sources.topic: PROG_LIST: program type filters, name patterns, skip restrictions, format widths, optional index and contradictory syntax/table status listing

implemented.context: Current/attached Programs and task Program identities supply PC rows; explicit immutable ProgramCatalog supplies all six types without loading code
implemented.filtering: Case-insensitive star-only patterns, type filters 1..8, distinct sorted name/type pairs
implemented.pagination: ARRAY-sized pages, restricted nonnegative skip and optional initialized cursor offset in rows remaining after skip
implemented.formats: Name or 12/36 padded name columns plus space and two-letter type; no truncation, clear unused slots only on success
implemented.outputs: Capture once in source order; disjoint exact writable references; prevalidate complete batch; status-only portable failures
implemented.persistence: Explicit catalog metadata only; attached executable code and tasks require reattachment
implemented.observations: program_listing_policy and source-located value-free service operation/request records

portable_choices: Seven required arguments including status, plus an optional eighth cursor, follow the parameter table despite the abbreviated syntax line
ProgramCatalog uses 1..36 character ASCII identifiers and canonical type names; duplicate supplied identities are rejected
Metadata does not imply executable programs or populated variable namespaces
Bindings, filenames and external callbacks do not create directory entries
Task aliases do not replace source Program names; completed or stopped Programs remain attached
Cursor is an explicit row offset rather than a native opaque directory index; reset on query/context change
Portable status 0 success, 2 invalid options and 3 text/format capacity; failures preserve all other outputs
remaining: Native directory order and index encoding
